scope: Ordinary published bar opening times. Not a guarantee of service on 9–14 November 2026; bank holidays, private events, last orders and food times can differ.

albion-chester.note: Historic split-session pub; Wednesday and Sunday closed; check before a Chester trip.

arden-arms-stockport.note: Lunch matters on Wednesday; a pub being open later does not mean the kitchen is.

augustus-john.note: University-run venue: Saturday opening during term time only; summer and Christmas schedules differ.

balance-brewing-blending.note: Regular taproom pattern; advertised cider-club meetings or ticketed events may differ.

blackedge-brewery-bar-horwich.note: CAMRA's matching food times may reflect snacks/pop-ups only; no dependable full daily kitchen is established.

britons-protection.note: Hours shown on the official operator website. '00:00' means closing at midnight after the named day.

bundobust-brewery-manchester.note: CAMRA says closing times are *or later*, not a precise last-orders guarantee.

bundobust-liverpool.note: Operator: kitchen closes one hour before the bar. Beer hall and kitchen are the same listed opening period.

cask-stoneycroft.note: CAMRA listing last updated 2024; verify hours shortly before a dedicated detour.

chorlton-tap.note: Kitchen runs only on selected days; not equivalent to bar opening.

circus-tavern.note: CAMRA warns actual closing and even opening may vary with season and customers; do not rely on a minute-perfect arrival.

cloudwater-unit-9.note: Taproom hours are separate from booked brewery tours; confirm tour slots.

dead-crafty-beer-company.note: CAMRA listing last updated 2025; recheck directly.

dunham-apple-barn.note: Current operator lists Saturday and Sunday only, conflicting with an older CAMRA schedule. Saturday 14 is not usable due to your morning flight; not a practical default.

longford-tap.note: CAMRA explicitly says closing may be 'or later'; confirm on the day.

lower-turks-head.note: May close earlier when quiet, according to CAMRA.

magnet-stockport.note: Wednesday kitchen no service; Thursday–Saturday evening food only per CAMRA.

marble-arch.note: Official times are **last bar orders**, not necessarily departure time; Tuesday CLOSED despite a conflicting CAMRA timetable. Food service ends earlier (Monday–Thursday last food orders 20:00).

northern-monk-manchester.note: CAMRA lists food from 11:00 though the bar is listed from noon; check actual kitchen service.

queens-arms-patricroft.note: Heritage-only exception; do not assume cask availability.

rivington-brewery-tap.note: Rural brewery tap; operator events and bank-holiday hours can differ. Tuesday closed.

runaway-brewery-tap-stockport.note: Closed Wednesday; do not include as a Wednesday Stockport stop without an explicitly announced event.

salutation-hulme.note: Term-time campus pub: student-union trading and real ale may be reduced outside teaching. CAMRA says closings 'or later'.

steelfish-taproom.note: CAMRA explicitly warns that these recently opened premises' hours may vary.

track-brewery-tap.note: Published food windows are shorter; taproom hours can change, confirm the date.

udders-orchard-cidery.note: No regular weekly opening. Producer advertises Saturday 7 November 2026 noon–20:00 and Sunday 8 November noon–19:00, both BEFORE the trip starts Monday 9 November; December openings are not relevant. Do not convert these events into ordinary weekly hours.

waters-green-tavern-macclesfield.note: Sunday may close later than 18:30 depending on custom.
